alshanex_familiars:birds_spell: Summons little birds that will cheer you and your allies, giving you a little boost for some time.
alshanex_familiars:default_note: Perform a simple melody to hurt enemies, known to be so catchy that people can't get away from it.
alshanex_familiars:end_mayhem: This spell allows you to become the ruler of the end while casting it, allowing you to use the full power of the end dimension to kill your target.
alshanex_familiars:explosion_melody: Performs an outrageous melody that traps the enemies and annihilates them with an explosive climax.
alshanex_familiars:fire_fist: Strike with a powerful fire fist burning everything in the way.
alshanex_familiars:guardian_angel: Calls the angels to play an angelic melody that will heal and protect you and your allies.
alshanex_familiars:harp_symphony: Performs a rumbling melody that hurts and stuns the enemy.
alshanex_familiars:ice_age: Freeze everything around you, covering the world in ice.
alshanex_familiars:ice_chamber: Shoot a freezing ray that will freeze an area around the impact and sometimes even the enemy itself.
alshanex_familiars:lullaby: Start playing a slow-paced, harmonious melody to make your enemies sleepy.
alshanex_familiars:megido: Summon the wrath of the heavens, striking with lightnings every entity that dares to come around.
alshanex_familiars:music_bolt: Shoots a simple note towards the enemy.
alshanex_familiars:sonata: Start playing a fast-paced song for everyone to hear, an harmonious melody to hurt your enemies.
alshanex_familiars:summon_shadows: Call shadow knights into your world, they are invulnerable and will pursue the enemy relentlessly.
antimagic:anti_magic_slash: Releases a blade of Anti-Magic that flies forward, dealing damage, purging buffs, and obliterating enemy spells in its path.
antimagic:black_mantle: Channels a 2-second cast bar to shroud yourself in Anti-Magic, gaining Speed and a Black Glowing aura for 30 seconds at the cost of 1 hunger drumstick.
antimagic:black_ward: Unleashes an explosive dome of Anti-Magic that destroys all incoming hostile projectiles, knocks back and silences nearby enemies, and grants the caster temporary damage resistance.
antimagic:demonic_assimilation: Channels the power of the anti-magic demon, granting superhuman strength, speed, resistance, and flight.
antimagic:summon_demon_destroyer: Manifests or toggles the Demon-Destroyer Sword in your main hand.
antimagic:summon_demon_dweller: Manifests or toggles the Demon-Dweller Sword in your main hand.
antimagic:summon_demon_slayer: Manifests or toggles the Demon-Slayer Sword in your main hand.
antimagic:sword_call: Calls all of your thrown Anti-Magic swords flying at high speed through the air directly to you.
cursed_school:apostate_crown: Don a crown mode for power or shell, paid upfront with +20 Corruption. Legendary — learn via Unsigned Page.
cursed_school:ash_guard: Wraps you in an ash shell that blocks incoming projectiles.
cursed_school:ash_needle: Fires a piercing ash needle that applies Rot Stack on contact.
cursed_school:ash_pack: Summon ash hounds that bite with Wither for 10 minutes.
cursed_school:black_root: Hard-roots a foe in place under heavy wither pressure.
cursed_school:black_verse: Raises an anti-magic domain that stifles spellcasting nearby.
cursed_school:blight_step: Blink a short distance, leaving rot puddles at both start and landing.
cursed_school:bone_toll: Strikes and banks Toll Marks you can cash later (up to five).
cursed_school:call_clerk: Summon an Inkbound Clerk that stamps Corruption Brand on hit.
cursed_school:chain_of_remorse: Links a primary target to nearby foes so pulsed damage chains between them.
cursed_school:choir_of_flies: Steers a biting fly swarm along your look cone.
cursed_school:crow_feast: Sends a flurry of pecks; landing enough blinds the victim.
cursed_school:debt_spike: Spikes a foe for Corruption-scaled damage. Against mobs, also applies an Owed DoT; other players never gain Corruption or Owed.
cursed_school:decay_field: Leaves a decaying trail under your feet that damages those who linger.
cursed_school:eclipse_maw: Pulls enemies inward, then crushes them in an eclipse maw.
cursed_school:finished_margin: Domain pulse that executes branded foes below a quarter health. Legendary — learn via Unsigned Page.
cursed_school:grave_dust: Bursts a lingering dust cloud that keeps choking enemies for a few seconds.
cursed_school:greedy_margin: Discounts your next Cursed casts' mana cost while adding extra Corruption each time.
cursed_school:hatch_cysts: Hatch a swarm of Cyst Mites that stack Rot for 20 minutes.
cursed_school:hex_barrage: Plants Hex Seals on foes in a look-cone without detonating them.
cursed_school:hollow_bite: Devours held food into mana, with unclean foods granting a larger restore.
cursed_school:invoice: Marks a trap invoice that detonates when the victim casts or heals.
cursed_school:issue_invoice: Summon a skeletal collector whose arrows shred armor.
cursed_school:leech_thread: Channels a siphon thread that heals you and restores mana each tick.
cursed_school:margin_pact: Self-buff pact that strengthens you while taxing +1 Corruption for the duration.
cursed_school:marrow_drain: Drains marrow for damage, wounding the target while granting you Absorption.
cursed_school:night_ledger: Opens the night ledger: stronger Cursed power in darkness than in bright day.
cursed_school:pale_lantern: Reveals hostiles with Glowing and burns undead with ongoing pale light.
cursed_school:rot_bolt: Embeds a Rot Cyst on hit, or pops an existing cyst into contagious spores.
cursed_school:rotting_rain: Calls a storm of wither rain that stacks Rot on everything beneath it.
cursed_school:ruin_slash: Cone slash that shreds armor on up to five enemies in front of you.
cursed_school:severed_tithe: Heavy strike that refunds mana and healing if it kills.
cursed_school:soot_shroud: Cloaks you in soot stealth; breaking the shroud amplifies your next hit.
cursed_school:stain_brand: Brands a target for execute synergy and Finished Margin domain kills.
cursed_school:testament_of_ash: Nova of ash that seals the ground afterward. Legendary — learn via Unsigned Page.
cursed_school:thrice_signed_name: Fires a triple raycast burst that echoes your signed name. Legendary — learn via Unsigned Page.
cursed_school:umbral_coffin: Cages a target in an immobilizing umbral coffin.
cursed_school:unsigned_judgment: Call a Margin Wither for 30 minutes. Legendary — learn via Unsigned Page. Requires Corruption 80000+.
cursed_school:wailing_dirge: Fear cone that punishes enemies who try to flee the dirge.
cursed_school:withering_touch: Melee touch that withers the target and deals bonus damage against already-withered foes.
esoteric_spell:aegis_barrier: Creates a barrier that reduces magic damage for allies inside it.
esoteric_spell:array_device: Each device independently finds a target, teleports above it and periodically fires a beam.
esoteric_spell:aspis_soul_barrier: Creates a barrier that grants allies Aspis Soul, reducing incoming damage.
esoteric_spell:auto_arrow_magic: Creates an Auto Arrow magic circle over the caster. The circle fires piercing barrier arrows at the locked target once per second.
esoteric_spell:auto_device: Summons automatic arcane devices that follow behind you in a ring formation.
esoteric_spell:auto_javelin_magic: Creates an Auto Javelin magic circle over the caster. The circle fires larger piercing barrier javelins at the locked target every 1.5 seconds.
esoteric_spell:auto_lances_magic: Creates an Auto Lances magic circle over the caster. The circle fires piercing barrier lances at the locked target every 2 seconds.
esoteric_spell:barrier_aura: Creates a moving aura that grants Protection to allies. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.
esoteric_spell:blast_magic: Must target an entity. Channels magical energy at the target, then detonates in a planar splash.
esoteric_spell:bless_barrier: Creates a barrier that heals allies every 0.5 seconds.
esoteric_spell:brave_aura: Creates a moving aura that grants Brave to allies. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.
esoteric_spell:cannon_magic: The first cast opens a charge window. Casting again fires a golden energy beam. Each activation is handled as a single-stage spell. Charging cannot be copied, while firing can be copied by Symphony, Chronos Shift, and Origin Devices.
esoteric_spell:cast_barrier: Creates a barrier that continuously grants the Iron's Spells Haste status to the caster and their summons, boosting movement, attack and cast speed.
esoteric_spell:chase_device: Commands automatic devices to fire chase beams after you deal Esoteric spell damage.
esoteric_spell:chronos_shift_magic: Copies the last Esoteric spell cast recently. Familiar, aura, barrier and excluded spells are not copied.
esoteric_spell:counter_device: Commands automatic devices to counterattack enemies that damage allies within range.
esoteric_spell:crash_magic: Calls down fast crash meteors at the target position. Symphony can copy this spell.
esoteric_spell:cycle_aura: Creates a moving aura that grants Cycle to allies. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.
esoteric_spell:dual_bringer: Clears the previous conversion when channeling starts. On completion, excess spell power becomes attack damage and attack damage becomes spell power; the calculated values remain fixed until expiration.
esoteric_spell:echanted_burst: Bursts the locked target and grants Magic Blade Enhancement, increasing Enchant Slash and Element Slash damage by 25%.
esoteric_spell:echanted_spell: Successful weapon hits lock the target and instantly cast Auto Arrow, Auto Javelin, Auto Lances, Blast, or Storm at random without mana cost. All five share one trigger cooldown.
esoteric_spell:element_slash: Launches a slower slash along the view direction. Damage benefits from current attack damage and main-hand enchantments, but cannot trigger Conversion or Enchanting.
esoteric_spell:esoteric_missile: Launch an Esoteric Missile and gain Esoteric Technique.
esoteric_spell:esoteric_shackle: After charging, bind non-allied entities in the targeted area; each shackle can be destroyed independently.
esoteric_spell:esoteric_step: Teleports toward the aimed position after channeling. A destination beyond the maximum range is clamped along the same direction.
esoteric_spell:ether_barrier: Creates a barrier that grants allies Ether, increasing knockback resistance, movement speed and cast speed.
esoteric_spell:familia_blizzard: Commands an existing familiar to channel a blizzard at the target position, pulling and damaging enemies inside it.
esoteric_spell:familia_cat_summon: Summons a black cat familiar at the target position. While present, it grants its owner Familia: Black Cat.
esoteric_spell:familia_imperial_ray: Commands an existing familiar to summon a descending imperial ray that damages enemies it touches.
esoteric_spell:familia_lightning: Commands an existing familiar to strike the target location with lightning.
esoteric_spell:familia_meteor: Commands an existing familiar to call down meteors at the target location.
esoteric_spell:familia_research: Grants Magic Circuit, reducing familiar cast time and increasing damage dealt by familiar spells.
esoteric_spell:familia_symphony: Grants Spell Symphony. While active, familiars have a chance to copy some Esoteric spells with the Magic prefix.
esoteric_spell:fast_reaction_aura: Creates a moving aura that gives allies a chance to dodge incoming attacks. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.
esoteric_spell:finale_guide: Commands your familiar to gain Guide, letting it automatically channel Lightning, Blizzard or Meteor while idle.
esoteric_spell:finale_magic: Marks three concentric circles, then raises three vertical beams from the center in sequence.
esoteric_spell:finale_mana_regan: Commands your familiar to gain Mana Feedback, restoring mana to its owner when familiar spells finish.
esoteric_spell:finale_stone_barrier: Commands your familiar to channel Stone Skin, converting shield absorption into effect duration.
esoteric_spell:flowing_barrier: While channeling and while the effect lasts, sourced damage is reduced and restores mana based on its original amount.
esoteric_spell:gloria_barrier: Creates a barrier that grants allies Gloria, increasing armor and armor toughness.
esoteric_spell:guandian_beam_magic: Creates a light-guard barrier. Barrier-school spell casts inside it can fire guiding beam projectiles at hostile targets.
esoteric_spell:guard_barrier: Creates a barrier that absorbs damage for you and your allies.
esoteric_spell:guardian_barrier: Creates a barrier that grants Guarding to its caster and redirects enemies targeting allies inside it.
esoteric_spell:health_aura: Creates a moving aura that heals allies every second and grants Energy Aura to the caster. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.
esoteric_spell:immunity_aura: Creates a moving aura that has a chance every 2 seconds to cleanse one random non-beneficial effect from each ally. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.
esoteric_spell:impact_magic: Unleashes a shockwave that damages enemies and knocks them back with force increasing with distance.
esoteric_spell:laser_magic: Fires a sequence of esoteric lasers. When copied by Symphony, it fires once every 0.5 seconds until all shots are spent.
esoteric_spell:limit_break: Grants Limit Break. Each level grants 2.5% spell power and 5% cast-time and cooldown reduction.
esoteric_spell:magic_blade_absorb: Successful weapon hits restore mana while the effect lasts. The restored amount scales with spell and Esoteric spell power.
esoteric_spell:magic_blade_conversion: After a weapon successfully hits, consumes mana to convert part of the wielder's attack damage into Esoteric spell damage. Conversion and Enchanting can both trigger.
esoteric_spell:magic_blade_enchant_slash: Slashes forward. Conversion and Enchanting effects each add a separate hit at 50% of their normal damage.
esoteric_spell:magic_blade_enchanting: After a weapon successfully hits, adds Esoteric spell damage based on that weapon's displayed attack damage without consuming extra mana.
esoteric_spell:magic_skin: Reduces damage according to current mana percentage without consuming mana. More remaining mana provides more reduction.
esoteric_spell:mana_aura: Creates a moving aura that restores mana to allied players every second and grants Energy Aura to the caster. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.
esoteric_spell:mana_change_barrier: Creates a barrier that restores mana to allies in range instantly and every second thereafter.
esoteric_spell:mana_resonance: Balances your current health and mana ratios, then grants Mana Resonance.
esoteric_spell:maximizer_change_barrier: Instantly cancels your own Mana Change Barrier and injects the remaining mana to be restored into allies in range (cast inside a Rapid Change Barrier for Full Mana).
esoteric_spell:missile_device: Commands automatic devices to periodically fire magic missiles at nearby hostile targets.
esoteric_spell:namesis_magic: The first cast accumulates Namesis levels and cannot be copied. The second cast requires a target and can be copied by Symphony, Chronos Shift, and Origin Devices; copied Namesis barriers are independent.
esoteric_spell:prayer_barrier: Creates a barrier that grants allies Prayer, increasing spell power.
esoteric_spell:protection_barrier: Creates a barrier that reduces non-magic incoming damage for allies inside it.
esoteric_spell:qadal_magic: Grants Qadal. Your next Esoteric spell consumes extra mana, gains stronger spell-power scaling, and adds mana overload.
esoteric_spell:quick_motion_aura: Creates a moving aura that grants Quick Motion to allies. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.
esoteric_spell:rapid_change_barrier: Creates a barrier where casting Mana Change Barrier boosts per-second mana restore by 20%, and casting Maximizer Change Barrier grants allies the Full Mana status.
esoteric_spell:resurrection: Records Resurrection data for the caster and nearby allies. Consumed to prevent death; Stasis damage or a Stasis effect prevents activation.
esoteric_spell:sanctuary_barrier: Creates a barrier that reduces small damage hits taken by allies inside it.
esoteric_spell:spell_calibration: Grants Spell Calibration. Esoteric spell damage reduces the target's invulnerability time by 20% per level.
esoteric_spell:storm_magic: Creates a stationary storm at the target location, pulling enemies inward and damaging them every second.
esoteric_spell:suppress_device: Devices track the locked target, fire several rapid suppression volleys, then resume their prior command.
esoteric_spell:union_sword: Requires more than 15 seconds of Magic Blade Enhancement. Releases a horizontal slash and consumes 15 seconds, then consumes up to 15 more seconds and releases a vertical slash after 0.5 seconds.
esoteric_spell:vulcan_device: Selects up to five targets. Selected devices vanish, appear above their targets, then fire heavy Vulcan beams in sequence.
esoteric_spell:wall_barrier: Creates a barrier that damages and repels hostile mobs targeting you or your allies; projectiles not fired by you or your summons are forced to the ground.
irons_chronomancy:body_rewind: First cast records your position, health and hunger. Cast again before the anchor expires to return; expiry only removes the anchor. Legendary can consume a safe anchor to prevent death. Inventory, mana, cooldowns and world state are never rolled back.
irons_chronomancy:borrowed_time: Accelerates movement and ongoing health/mana regeneration for six seconds, then locks movement for two seconds. The approaching lock is signalled in advance. Reconnecting or changing dimension cannot erase the payback.
irons_chronomancy:chronal_bolt: Fires a focused temporal lance at the target.
irons_chronomancy:chrono_step: Steps safely along your aim and leaves a player-sized, two-HP temporal decoy for two seconds. Only hostiles already pursuing you may switch to it. The step cannot pass through blocked body space.
irons_chronomancy:dilated_zone: Creates a fixed zone that slows eligible living entities and projectiles, including supported flying and custom movement. The caster is immune to their own zone. Higher levels improve coverage and lifetime.
irons_chronomancy:paradox: Marks one enemy for three temporal strikes, each based on its maximum health. Highest level: 7% per strike, 21% total before legitimate mitigation. Ordinary spell-power bonuses cannot amplify that percentage. No splash damage.
irons_chronomancy:prepared_cut_back: Sneak-cast to restore yourself, or aim at an ally without sneaking. Restores 40% of maximum health and up to eight food points for players. Hostile targets cannot be healed. Higher levels improve reach and mana efficiency.
irons_chronomancy:slowdown: Slows an eligible enemy and its temporal movement. Downward marks and slow clock hands distinguish it from Speedup. Higher levels improve duration, range and slowing strength.
irons_chronomancy:speedup: Sneak to accelerate yourself. Otherwise, aim at a teammate, owned companion or clearly friendly creature; with no friendly target, you accelerate yourself. Hostile enemies are never accelerated. Temporal movement and upward clock marks distinguish the positive effect; higher levels improve duration, reach and strength.
irons_chronomancy:stasis: Suspends one eligible target in time. A frozen clock marks the effect; normal movement resumes afterwards. Higher levels improve duration and reach. Scripted boss immunity and PvP restrictions are respected.
irons_chronomancy:target_rewind: First cast marks one eligible entity and its current position. The second cast returns that same entity, not a new target. The native return timer and world echo show the active mark. Health is unchanged; expiry never teleports automatically.
irons_chronomancy:temporal_anchors: Retired compatibility entry. Existing worlds, scrolls and books remain readable, but this ability cannot be cast or obtained. Use Body Rewind or Target Rewind.
irons_chronomancy:temporal_wall: Raises a translucent temporal barrier. Eligible hostile creatures and projectiles cannot simply cross it; the caster and permitted allies remain free. Higher levels widen and heighten the wall without making it opaque.
irons_chronomancy:time_debt: For 30 seconds, take 50% of incoming mitigated damage immediately and borrow the other half. Over the following 30 seconds, repay 70% of that debt in six payments, five seconds apart. New damage is normal during repayment. Reconnecting pauses, but never erases, the debt.
irons_chronomancy:time_stop: Suspends eligible creatures and moving entities inside a local field, including Creeper fuses and projectiles. The caster and their own projectiles remain free. Boss exceptions and PvP rules still apply; world time and cooldowns continue.
irons_spellbooks:abyssal_shroud: Cloak yourself with the shadows of the abyss, granting the ability to evade any attack for a short duration of time.
irons_spellbooks:acid_orb: Spit an orb of acid, splashing in a radius upon impact and rending creatures hit, melting away and reducing their armor
irons_spellbooks:acupuncture: Around a targeted creature, create a field of blood needles in every direction, shooting down and healing you for 25% of damage done
irons_spellbooks:angel_wing: Cast to gain wings made of holy energy, acting as an elytra, for a brief period of time.
irons_spellbooks:arcane_shackle: Hurl a bundle of arcane chains. Upon hitting a creature, cause three chains to bind it to the ground, each applying a tethering force. On miss, three chains lash out to unique nearby creatures. Chains can be damaged or dispelled.
irons_spellbooks:arrow_volley: Around a targeted creature or block, summon a rolling wave of magical arrows from the sky.
irons_spellbooks:ascension: Cast to strike lightning at your feet and ascend quickly into the air, and gain reduced gravity for a short duration. The lightning bolt deals damage and knocks back creatures struck.
irons_spellbooks:ball_lightning: Conjure an orb of lightning that slowly moves forward, damaging creatures it phases through and bouncing off blocks.
irons_spellbooks:black_hole: Around a targeted location, create a fissure into the void, manifesting a black hole that will suck in nearby creatures and slowly crush them to death
irons_spellbooks:blaze_storm: Hold to unleash a barrage of blaze fireballs, shooting rapidly but wildly in front of you and igniting any creatures or blocks hit.
irons_spellbooks:blessing_of_life: Cast to target any creature, showing a glowing outline. Completing the cast will heal this creature.
irons_spellbooks:blight: Target a creature to blight them, reducing their incoming healing and outgoing damage
irons_spellbooks:blizzard: Channel a slow-moving, swirling blizzard at a targeted location, causing freezing wind and snow to pull creatures into the center of the vortex.
irons_spellbooks:blood_needles: Create a ring of needles made from blood and fire them forward, skewering targets and healing you for 25% of damage done
irons_spellbooks:blood_slash: Slash forward to send out a concentrated blade of blood, slicing through creatures and healing for 15% of damage done.
irons_spellbooks:blood_step: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, or directly behind any targeted creature. Gain a short duration of true invisibility upon reaching your destination.
irons_spellbooks:burning_dash: Quickly launch yourself forward in a haze of fire, searing creatures you pass through while in a blaze.
irons_spellbooks:chain_creeper: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a ring of creeper heads that falls to the ground and explodes. Any creature killed by this blast will conjure another, smaller, ring of creeper heads. This can chain multiple times.
irons_spellbooks:chain_lightning: Start a chain of lightning from a targeted creature, causing waves of zapping magic to cascade to nearby creatures
irons_spellbooks:charge: Imbue yourself with the power of lightning, increasing your speed and combat abilities.
irons_spellbooks:cleanse: Pray to a divine magic to cleanse yourself and nearby allies of harmful status effects.
irons_spellbooks:cloud_of_regeneration: Hold to slowly heal friendly creatures within a radius around you.
irons_spellbooks:cone_of_cold: Hold to cast out a cone of cold energy, freezing creatures in its path.
irons_spellbooks:counterspell: Cast to interrupt any targeted magical process, such as a casting creature or a magical projectile.
irons_spellbooks:devour: Pull in a nearby creature and attack them with a bite, leeching 15% of damage done as health. If the creature is killed, you temporarily gain additional max HP. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Yorhavich.
irons_spellbooks:divine_smite: With a fervor of holy energy, swing forth your weapon, doing a melee area attack. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
irons_spellbooks:dragon_breath: Hold to spew a cone of dragon breath forwards. Each time a creature is hit, there is a chance to create a pool of dragon breath at their feet.
irons_spellbooks:earthquake: Conjure an earthquake around a targeted creature or location, causing tremors to ripple through the ground, damaging and slowing creatures in the area.
irons_spellbooks:echoing_strikes: Non-magical attacks will create an echo, producing a spectral sword to slam down in an area, or a piercing magical arrow to shoot the same target. Echoes do a percent of the original attack's damage.
irons_spellbooks:eldritch_blast: Fire rays of pure, devastating energy.
irons_spellbooks:electrocute: Hold to manifest a cone of electrical energy, damaging creatures in its path.
irons_spellbooks:evasion: Cast to imbue yourself with ender energy. Upon being attacked while under its effects, you will immediately teleport within a short radius and avoid taking any damage. Only a finite amount of hits can be dodged before the effect immediately wears off.
irons_spellbooks:fang_strike: Conjure a line of evoker fangs in front of you, in classic illager fashion.
irons_spellbooks:fang_swirl: Target a creature or block to conjure a spiraling zone of evoker fangs in a radius.
irons_spellbooks:fang_ward: Conjure protective rings of evoker fangs around you, in classic illager fashion.
irons_spellbooks:fire_arrow: Aim an arrow made of fiery magic that will deal direct damage on impact and explode for half damage in a small radius around it. It flies straight for a duration before gravity affects it.
irons_spellbooks:fire_breath: Hold to spew a cone of fire outwards, igniting creatures and blocks in its path.
irons_spellbooks:fireball: Manifest and throw a ball of fire, exploding and dealing massive damage on impact.
irons_spellbooks:firebolt: Shoot a small projectile of fire, igniting whatever it hits.
irons_spellbooks:firecracker: Instantaneously conjure a firework where you look that explodes in a small radius around it.
irons_spellbooks:firefly_swarm: Emanate a swarm of violent fireflies, following a targeted creature and dealing aoe damage. If the initial target dies, the last harmed creature will be targeted.
irons_spellbooks:flaming_barrage: Repeatedly cast to shoot individual small fireballs, which home towards your cursor, or the creature your cursor is targeting.
irons_spellbooks:flaming_strike: Unleash a sweeping melee attack in the form of a wreath of flames. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
irons_spellbooks:fortify: Upon casting, fortify every friendly creature within a radius around you, giving them temporary HP.
irons_spellbooks:frost_step: Teleport to where you are looking, leaving behind a shadow of ice. This shadow will take nearby aggro, and shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.
irons_spellbooks:frostbite: Imbue yourself with a magical Frostbiting power, making any fully-frozen creature you kill turn into an Ice Shadow. Ice Shadows shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.
irons_spellbooks:frostwave: Cascade a wave of frost magic in a radius around you, afflicting creatures with chilled. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.
irons_spellbooks:gluttony: Turn your stomach into an arcane furnace, turning eaten food into mana for a duration.
irons_spellbooks:gravity_fissure: Split from the air a miniature Black Hole that moves forward in a line, pulling nearby creatures into its gravity well, but dealing no damage.
irons_spellbooks:greater_heal: A more powerful but much slower version of heal, this spell will completely heal yourself upon being casted.
irons_spellbooks:guiding_bolt: Fire a slow bolt of holy energy. Creatures hit will gain the Guided effect, homing nearby projectiles in towards them
irons_spellbooks:gust: Conjure a strong gust of wind, knocking back creatures in a conical shape, causing damage if they impact a wall
irons_spellbooks:haste: To a targeted creature, or yourself if no creature is targeted, apply the Hastened effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.
irons_spellbooks:heal: Cast to infuse yourself with holy energy and immediately regain health.
irons_spellbooks:healing_circle: Around a targeted creature or block, place a stationary circle of holy magic that heals allies within
irons_spellbooks:heartstop: Cast to inflict yourself with Heartstop, an effect that makes you temporarily invulnerable. However, once it wears off, you take 50% of all damage accumulated while under its effects.
irons_spellbooks:heat_surge: Emanate a surge of fiery magic, igniting and rending creatures in a radius around you. Rended creatures have reduced armor.
irons_spellbooks:ice_block: Conjure a giant chunk of ice above a targeted creature or block. After a short delay, it will fall down and explode for area frost damage, doing additional damage to any creatures hit on the way down.
irons_spellbooks:ice_spikes: Unleash a cascading line of ice magic, creating ice crystals that emerge from the ground. The final spike does full damage, and will emerge early if a creature within range is targeted.
irons_spellbooks:ice_tomb: Encase yourself in a protective tomb of ice, providing healing while within, absorbing one hit or counterspell before breaking. Dismount to leave the tomb.
irons_spellbooks:icicle: Fire a piercing bolt of cold energy in the form of an icicle, freezing those it touches.
irons_spellbooks:invisibility: Cast to briefly grant yourself true invisibility, which hides armor and held items, but immediately wears off upon dealing damage. Mobs also lose aggro.
irons_spellbooks:lightning_bolt: Down from the heavens, summon a bolt of lightning.
irons_spellbooks:lightning_lance: Hold to charge a spear made of lightning. Release to throw it like a javelin, dealing high damage to the creature it hits.
irons_spellbooks:lob_creeper: Lob the head of a creeper forward that explodes in a medium radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.
irons_spellbooks:magic_arrow: Hold to charge a piercing arrow made of arcane energy. This arrow has no gravity and can travel through blocks.
irons_spellbooks:magic_missile: Shoot a bolt of concentrated arcane magic. Also a trademark of every wizard.
irons_spellbooks:magma_bomb: Launch a bomb made from magma, exploding on impact and leaving a field of fire where it lands
irons_spellbooks:oakskin: The great power of oak infuses itself into your skin, granting damage reduction of any incoming damage for a duration.
irons_spellbooks:planar_sight: Shift your vision in between planes, gaining the ability to see creatures through solid material.
irons_spellbooks:pocket_dimension: Cast to transport yourself into a personal pocket dimension only you can access, giving a small free range area.
irons_spellbooks:poison_arrow: Charge a powerful arrow, imbued with poison magic, that will release a poisonous cloud upon impact
irons_spellbooks:poison_breath: Spew forth a cone of poison, damaging and poisoning creatures in its reach
irons_spellbooks:poison_splash: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a wave of poisonous magic that splashes down, damaging creatures hit and leaving behind a poisonous cloud
irons_spellbooks:portal: Creates two portals that allows players to travel back and forth between them.
irons_spellbooks:raise_dead: Cast to summon undead minions from the earth beneath you. The higher the power, the better equipment they will have.
irons_spellbooks:raise_hell: Slam down your weapon to wreath a fiery shockwave in a large radius around you. Damage scales based on the held weapon.
irons_spellbooks:ray_of_frost: Fire a beam of cold energy, dealing low damage but immediately applying freeze to the creature hit.
irons_spellbooks:ray_of_siphoning: Hold to cast a ray of necrotic energy that siphons health from creatures it hits, damaging them and healing you for 100% of damage done.
irons_spellbooks:recall: Warps you back to your spawn location, or world spawn if there is none.
irons_spellbooks:root: Around a targeted creature, sprout magical roots than entangle them and completely prevent non-magical movement
irons_spellbooks:sacrifice: Target one of your magic summons to cause them to explode, killing them instantly, and dealing large damage in the area around them. The summon's remaining health boosts the damage dealt and radius of explosion.
irons_spellbooks:scapegoat: Conjure a magical decoy in the form of a goat, which takes aggro from nearby hostile mobs and runs off into the distance, taunting them for a duration.
irons_spellbooks:scorch: In a targeted area, erupt a scorch of fiery magic, damaging creatures in the zone and leaving a field of fire.
irons_spellbooks:sculk_tentacles: From where you look, erupt a mass of sculk energy in the form of wailing tentacles, damaging and blinding creatures caught in the chaos.
irons_spellbooks:shadow_slash: Dash forward with a arcing slash of arcane energy, striking creatures in an area. Projectiles hit are deflected. Scales off held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
irons_spellbooks:shield: Conjure a stationary shield of arcane energy where you look that will block projectiles and prevent creatures from passing.
irons_spellbooks:shockwave: Coalesce a surge of electrical power, and unleash it in a devastating shockwave, blasting exposed creatures.
irons_spellbooks:slow: Apply the Slowed effect to a targeted creature, decreasing its movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.
irons_spellbooks:snowball: Conjure a giant snowball and throw it forward, bursting into a frosty field and Chilling creatures in a surrounding radius on impact. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.
irons_spellbooks:sonic_boom: Blast forth a sonic boom of immense power, passing through solid material and harming all creatures in its path.
irons_spellbooks:spectral_hammer: Conjure a spectral hammer out from where you look that will mine all connected stone-type blocks in a cube where it hits, leaving only ores and rubble behind.
irons_spellbooks:spider_aspect: Instill yourself with poisonous magic, dealing additional melee, ranged, or spell damage creatures that are poisoned
irons_spellbooks:starfall: Target a single area and continuously rain down arcane comets from above for the duration of the spell
irons_spellbooks:stomp: With a magic force, stomp the ground in front of you and send a short tremor forward through the ground, damaging creatures in its path.
irons_spellbooks:summon_ender_chest: Apparate your Ender Chest inventory upon casting.
irons_spellbooks:summon_horse: Conjure a spectral steed that will follow you around and only let you ride. The horse's speed, health, and jump height scales with spell power.
irons_spellbooks:summon_polar_bear: Cast to summon a polar bear who will follow, protect, and fight for you, as well as providing a mount.
irons_spellbooks:summon_swords: Conjure a trio of spectral armaments to aid in battle: a brawling shortsword, a quick rapier, and a tanking claymore. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Hazentouvel.
irons_spellbooks:summon_vex: Cast to conjure vexes that will follow, protect, and fight for you.
irons_spellbooks:sunbeam: Funnel the power of the heavens into a beam of holy energy from above, smiting targets in an area.
irons_spellbooks:telekinesis: Reach out with a spectral force and grip a creature, forcing them towards your gaze. Creatures are susceptible to kinetic damage.
irons_spellbooks:teleport: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, leaving nothing but a cloud of ender energy behind.
irons_spellbooks:throw: Cast to throw your held item, dealing a base damage plus damage normally inflicted by the item.
irons_spellbooks:thunder_step: Teleport a short distance forward, creating a wake of lightning that damages creatures you teleport through.
irons_spellbooks:thunderstorm: Cast to conjure a thunderstorm centered around yourself, which strikes nearby creatures within sight with a small bolt of lightning every 2 seconds for the spell's duration.
irons_spellbooks:touch_dig: Use magic to break a block. Held items affect drops.
irons_spellbooks:volt_strike: Leap forward in a spinning voltaic attack, striking the first creature or surface you hit, and dealing a residual blast in a small area around around the impact.
irons_spellbooks:wall_of_fire: Recast to place anchor points, which erupts into a wall of fire when the cast finishes, or when the maximum length is reached. This wall blocks projectiles and ignites creatures that pass through it.
irons_spellbooks:wisp: Conjure a projectile of holy energy that will float towards nearby targets and deal damage upon impact.
irons_spellbooks:wither_skull: Launch a wither skull forward that explodes in a small radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.
iss_csw:arcane_infusion: Provides the Arcane Potency attribute to the infused equipment
iss_csw:barrage_volley: After a brief charge, continuously and rapidly fires a barrage of magic arrows forward
iss_csw:blizzard: Target a single area summon a blizzard from above for the duration of the spell
iss_csw:charge_ray_of_frost: fire a ray of frost at the target. The impacted area explodes, dealing secondary damage.
iss_csw:conjure_refreshment: Creates a magical cookie whose nutritional value scales with your Spell Power!
iss_csw:crimson_laceration: Unleashes a crimson slash that flies forward, widening as it travels and cutting through everything in its path. It can be attached to your melee attacks by spending an extra cast.
iss_csw:firefly_seeker: Summons a swarm of fireflies that automatically track and attack the targeted enemy, dealing continuous damage.
iss_csw:frostwhirl_slash: Spin unleash a frost-imbued sweeping melee attack. Damage scales with your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments
iss_csw:gust_pro: Summons a powerful gust of wind that knocks back and damages entities in front of you. Entities that collide with blocks take additional damage.
iss_csw:hemovaporize: Curses the target, causing their blood to magically vaporize, inflicting continuous life loss.
iss_csw:ice_plate: Increases Armor Modifier, but some is lost when attacked.
iss_csw:life_tap: Continuously drains health, but greatly reduces the cooldown of all spells and Continuously regen mana.
iss_csw:lob_creeper_chain: Lob the head of a creeper forward that explodes in a medium radius around the impact and will conjure a ring of creeper heads that falls to the ground and explodes. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.
iss_csw:mana_empowerment: Improves the defense of the infused equipment
iss_csw:marked_shot: First cast locks onto an enemy. During the duration, firing arrows will launch additional homing magic arrows at the target.
iss_csw:pinning_stake: Hurl a stake that ensnares the target with magical roots, preventing all non-magical movement. Damage is doubled against targets that cannot be entangled.
iss_csw:pure_arcane_missile: Fires an Arcane Missile that is affected by your spell cloak and special staff
iss_csw:rime_veil: Conjure a dense mist that grants true invisibility. Your first melee attack after breaking invisibility is a guaranteed critical hit
iss_csw:sand_maelstrom: Releases a stationary sand vortex. Cast again to enlarge it and move it in the direction you specify
iss_csw:spell_empowerment: improve you cast next spell's level
iss_csw:spellbreak_burst: After a short charge, release a magical shockwave that dispels nearby spells and deals bonus damage , will deals more damage to undead enemies.
iss_csw:summon_polar_bear: Cast to summon an ride on a faster polar bear who will follow, protect, and fight for you, as well as providing a mount, even can jump!
iss_csw:summon_spell_clone: Marks your current location. Your next other spell is cast by a clone instead. The clone then returns to the marked location.
iss_csw:time_sand: First cast starts a timer. Cast again to reduce the cooldown of all your spells by the average of the timed duration
iss_csw:totem_rite: Place a hollow totem at the target location to invoke a ritual circle. Enemies within the area continuously take damage. If it slays a target, an undead totem is successfully created.
iss_elden_ring:adulas_moonblade: Hold to chain slashes with a huge moonlight greatsword that strike all around the caster and freeze enemies, ending in a crescent wave that flies forward.
iss_elden_ring:cannon_of_haima: Lobs a heavy glintstone cannonball in an arc that explodes on impact, damaging everything in the blast.
iss_elden_ring:carian_greatsword: Hold to chain wide slashes with a huge glintstone greatsword that strike all around the caster.
iss_elden_ring:carian_phalanx: Summons nine glintblades in a semicircle above the caster's head. They wait for an enemy to come in range, then launch at it and track it.
iss_elden_ring:carian_slicer: Hold to chain quick, close-range slashes with a glintstone blade.
iss_elden_ring:collapsing_stars: Fires a scattered volley of eight gravity stars that pull the enemies they hit inwards.
iss_elden_ring:comet: Fires a glintstone comet straight ahead that explodes on impact.
iss_elden_ring:comet_azur: Hold to fire a huge, sustained beam of glintstone energy straight ahead. Cannot be cast while airborne unless flying.
iss_elden_ring:crystal_barrage: Hold to keep firing a spread of glintstone crystal shards. The caster must stand still on the ground.
iss_elden_ring:crystal_burst: Fires a spread of ten homing crystal shards at once. Can be cast while moving.
iss_elden_ring:founding_rain_of_stars: Calls down a rain of glintstone stars around the caster that strikes nearby enemies for several seconds.
iss_elden_ring:gavel_of_haima: Swings a giant glintstone hammer down on the ground ahead, hitting what it strikes directly and sending out a damaging shockwave.
iss_elden_ring:glintblade_phalanx: Summons five glintblades above the caster's head. They launch at and track enemies that come in range.
iss_elden_ring:glintstone_arc: Sweeps a wide arc of glintstone energy forward that hits every enemy it passes. Can be cast while moving.
iss_elden_ring:glintstone_comet: Fires a large glintstone comet that explodes on impact, damaging enemies around where it lands.
iss_elden_ring:glintstone_icecrag: Fires a homing shard of ice that bursts on impact, damaging and freezing enemies around it.
iss_elden_ring:glintstone_pebble: Fires a small, fast glintstone projectile.
iss_elden_ring:glintstone_stars: Fires three glintstone stars that home in on enemies.
iss_elden_ring:gravity_ball: Fires a gravity orb that pulls nearby enemies towards where it lands. Deals no damage.
iss_elden_ring:great_glintstone_shard: Fires a large glintstone shard that explodes on impact.
iss_elden_ring:greatblade_phalanx: Summons three large glintstone greatblades above the caster's head. They launch at and track enemies that come in range.
iss_elden_ring:loretta_greatbow: Draws a glintstone greatbow and looses a long-range, lightly homing arrow of magic.
iss_elden_ring:magic_glintblade: Conjures a single glintblade that hovers for a moment, then launches in the direction the caster was looking.
iss_elden_ring:meteorite: Hold to open a void overhead that rains meteorites onto the area ahead, each exploding where it lands.
iss_elden_ring:meteorite_of_astel: Hold to open rifts in the sky that drop larger meteorites onto the area ahead, each exploding where it lands.
iss_elden_ring:rock_sling: Pulls three boulders from the ground and hurls them at enemies, homing in on the nearest.
iss_elden_ring:spiral_shard: Fires a homing glintstone shard that spirals as it flies.
iss_elden_ring:star_shower: Fires six glintstone stars that home in on enemies.
iss_elden_ring:starlight: Summons a glowing star that lights up the caster's surroundings for two minutes. Casting it again replaces the old one.
iss_elden_ring:stars_of_ruin: Fires a volley of twelve stars of ruin that home in on enemies.
iss_elden_ring:swift_glintstone_shard: Fires a quick, lightly homing glintstone shard.
iss_elden_ring:terra_magica: Inscribes a glintstone sigil on the ground that raises the caster's spell power by 30% while they stand in it. Casting it again replaces the old one.
iss_magicfromtheeast:anchoring_kunai: Give the caster 3 anchoring kunai, dealing damage and apply Anchored Soul effect on hit
iss_magicfromtheeast:ashigaru_squad: Calling upon a squad of Spirit Ashigaru to aid in your battle
iss_magicfromtheeast:bagua_array_circle: Summon a Bagua Circle at designated area, damaging undead mob inside and give its owner Reversal Healing effect
iss_magicfromtheeast:bone_hands: Summon Spirit Bone Hands from the ground, the hands will slam your targets if they are in range
iss_magicfromtheeast:calamity_cut: Swing your weapon and strike down a deadly cut, the stronger your weapon, the more powerful the cut is
iss_magicfromtheeast:cloud_ride: Summon a Magical Cloud that can be ridden on for a moment
iss_magicfromtheeast:dragon_glide: Cast a unstoppable force dragon ahead the caster, deal damage to anything on its path, can break magic shield with a chance
iss_magicfromtheeast:drapes_of_reflectio: Create a magical Jade Drape, deflect any projectile hit it
iss_magicfromtheeast:jade_bullet: Throw a jade bullet that deal damage and create a small shockwave on impact
iss_magicfromtheeast:jade_judgement: Calling down an giant Jade Dao, deal a massive area of damage on impact
iss_magicfromtheeast:jiangshi_invoke: Summon 3 fast and furious Jiangshi to aid in your battle
iss_magicfromtheeast:kitsune_pack: Summon a pack of Kitsune that will fight for you, inflict soulburn effect on their bite
iss_magicfromtheeast:nephrite_slash: Striking ahead with a magical jade slash that make nephrite crystals emerging from the ground, spiking mobs above them
iss_magicfromtheeast:phantom_charge: Summon a group of samurai horseman that will charge directly into your enemy formation
iss_magicfromtheeast:punishing_heaven: Summon a Jade Executioner, a great warrior that will behead anything that's against you or the Celestial Court
iss_magicfromtheeast:revenant_of_honor: Summon a loyal Spirit Samurai to protect you from threats
iss_magicfromtheeast:soul_burst: Release a soul fire explosion at the caster position, damaging and burning souls of targets caught inside
iss_magicfromtheeast:soul_catalyst: After done casting, release a barrage of soul skulls, apply soulburn effect on hit
iss_magicfromtheeast:spirit_challenging: Extracting a part of target soul and then start the challenging. The soul can be attacked and an amount of the damage it took will be transferred to its owner. If the soul get destroyed or the owner try to run out of the challenging zone, they will get a debuff for a moment
iss_magicfromtheeast:splitting_shuriken: Throw a spirit shuriken at the target. Upon hit, split into smaller shurikens that deal half of the original damage.
iss_magicfromtheeast:sword_dance: Summoning magical swords around the caster. After a short delay, the swords will fly toward the last hurt target and stab them
iss_magicfromtheeast:underworld_aid: Calling upon 4 Impermanence to verdict targets in a circle, apply slowness, blindness, darkness effect and damage them for 4 second. The damage will scale based on the lost health of the target, up to target's 40% max health
somakespells:abyssal_burn: Conjures magic circles on the ground, expelling abyssal flames into the air.
somakespells:abyssal_orbs: Summons several abyssal orbs that fall from the sky and hit enemies with direct impact.
somakespells:apocalyptic_burst: Charges and releases a devastating explosion with high area damage.
somakespells:axe_cleave: Summons spectral axe cleaves to cut targets in front.
somakespells:blessed_connection: Links two targets with a blessed bond that shares a portion of healing between them until the effect expires or the targets move too far apart.
somakespells:blessing: Applies Blessing to yourself, granting Holy Spell Power and healing received bonus.
somakespells:blood_cut: Applies Blood Cut to yourself so your attacks deal increased blood cut damage.
somakespells:blood_rush: Applies Blood Dash to yourself, granting Blood Spell Power bonus and life steal on damage dealt.
somakespells:bloodbound_blade: Hurls the sword in your casting hand. A successful hit crystallizes the victim's blood, rooting them in place.
somakespells:bloodmark: Four casts mark points, then the next cast links them into a blood zone that persists and damages targets inside.
somakespells:bloody_legacy: Delivers a blow that strikes the ground, dealing damage to all enemies in a straight line.
somakespells:ceraunus_dash: Throws a summoned Ceraunus anchor that launches you toward the enemy.
somakespells:ceraunus_grasp: Throws a Ceraunus anchor that drags the enemy toward you.
somakespells:chain_connection: Binds two targets with an arcane chain, preventing them from moving too far away from each other.
somakespells:combustion: Applies Combustion to yourself, granting Fire Spell Power and Fire damage bonus for a certain period of time.
somakespells:comforting_lullaby: Channels a melody that heals nearby injured players in pulses, including the caster, but also makes each healed player Sleepy.
somakespells:crimson_reflection: Consumes three Spirit spells stored in a Red Soul Lantern to manifest the Red Echo. Defeat the reflection to awaken Red Soul.
somakespells:cursed_connection: Links two targets with a cursed bond that shares a portion of damage between them until the effect expires or the targets move too far apart.
somakespells:custodia_caeli: Marks the ground you are aiming at with a sacred preparation circle, then calls down Custodia Caeli, a rotating sigil that blesses every player inside with a long-lasting defensive buff.
somakespells:damned_demomans: Applies the Demned Demomans effect to yourself, arming an effect that makes you explode in flames.
somakespells:desert_wrath: Summons tornadoes around you that deal damage on impact.
somakespells:earthbound: Applies Earthbound to yourself, granting Geo and Armor bonus for a certain period of time.
somakespells:eldritch_gambit: Applies Eldritch Gambit to yourself as a temporary eldritch buff.
somakespells:ender_corruption: Inflicts Ender Corruption on yourself, granting Ender Spell Power bonus for a long period of time.
somakespells:eruption: Aim at the ground to summon an eruption that deals area damage.
somakespells:evocation_fortitude: Applies Evocation Fortitude, granting Evocation Spell Power bonus.
somakespells:fire_blast: Fire long-range compressed fire beams that can hit targets in front of you.
somakespells:fire_orbs: Summons several flame orbs that fall from the sky and hit enemies.
somakespells:firestorm_vortex: Summons a fiery vortex at the target point that pulls nearby enemies inward and scorches them over time.
somakespells:fragmented_requiem: Summons a perfect ring of fragmented swords from the earth. They cut once on the rise, hover briefly, then plunge back down for a second blood-soaked strike.
somakespells:funeral_bloom: Conjures a vast withered rose above the target area. In repeated waves, closed rose buds fall toward enemies, telegraph their impact, and bloom violently on the ground, dealing Blood damage and applying Wither. Striking already-withered enemies restores health to the caster.
somakespells:grave_sigil: Marks a grave sigil on the ground, then detonates it in two soul-charged waves: first a cross, then an X of spectral eruptions.
somakespells:guardian_connection: Links you to a target with a holy bond. While the bond lasts and you remain alive, the target becomes immune to damage and every prevented hit is redirected to you.
somakespells:halberd_strike: Summons 3 frontal columns of phantom halberds to strike distant enemies.
somakespells:hydro_slash: Conjures a water slash that deals damage to enemies in front. Damage gains bonus based on the sword in hand.
somakespells:ignis_shield: Summons an Ignis Shield with limited health to protect you from frontal impacts.
somakespells:incinerator_slash: Launches a devastating incinerating slash that deals direct fire damage.
somakespells:jingle_bell: Summons a bell that chimes, dealing area damage with each chime.
somakespells:lightning_ball: Throws a lightning ball that deals area damage.
somakespells:lightning_cut: Performs a lightning cut that deals damage and electrocutes the target.
somakespells:lightning_dance: Launches multiple lightning spears at nearby targets.
somakespells:lightning_field: Creates an electricity field that electrocutes the ground and deals continuous damage to enemies.
somakespells:lightning_lash: Cracks a lightning whip in front to deal direct damage and quickly pull the enemy toward you.
somakespells:lightning_spear: Throws a summoned lightning spear projectile that deals damage.
somakespells:lightning_strike: Summons a lightning strike and electrocutes the target.
somakespells:lightning_swarm: Releases a swarm of electric sparks against multiple targets.
somakespells:mirror_strike: Creates mirrored circles around you to deal area damage.
somakespells:overgrowth: Applies Overgrowth to yourself, granting Nature Spell Power bonus and increased bow damage.
somakespells:permafrost: Applies Permafrost to yourself, granting Ice Spell Power and cold damage bonus.
somakespells:phantom_barrage: Summons several cursed arrows that fly toward the target.
somakespells:procession_of_souls: Summons a procession of spiritual eruptions in a straight line in front of you.
somakespells:pumpkin_bomb: Throw an explosive pumpkin that deals impact and area damage.
somakespells:ram_tchum: Conjures a heavy sonic explosion that deals area damage.
somakespells:render_rush: Performs a frontal dash, dealing damage to anyone in the path.
somakespells:resonant_pulse: Releases a resonant pulse projectile that deals sonic damage.
somakespells:reverberation: Applies Reverberation, granting Sound Spell Power bonus for a certain period of time.
somakespells:ritual_flame: Launches a ritual flame at the Altar of Fire you are aiming at. If the setup is correct, the pedestal ritual begins.
somakespells:rose_secret: Wrap yourself in the Rose's Secret, becoming briefly untouchable while withered petals fall around you.
somakespells:sea_serpent: Summons the Scylla serpent, dealing damage to targets in front of you.
somakespells:sea_serpent_jet: Fires a Scylla serpent jet from the ground, dealing damage.
somakespells:slumber_melody: Plays a melody that puts nearby enemies to sleep.
somakespells:soul_bastion: Replicates the Possessed Paladin's soul shield assault, calling one outer ring of shields inward and a second inner ring outward.
somakespells:soul_grab: Maledictus Charge: upon selecting a target, you grab the enemy, launch yourself upward, and slam down with full force, dealing impact damage.
somakespells:soul_latch: Latches onto a target with a spectral stab, binding and pulling it toward you before dealing damage in a final releasing burst.
somakespells:soul_reprisal: Launches six cyan spectral daggers in a forward fan. The daggers reverse course after a short distance and can strike enemies again along their return path.
somakespells:soulfall_judgment: Unleashes a soul-charged impact around the caster and calls down a cyan-green formation of spectral blades.
somakespells:sovereign_armory: Opens a golden armory of portals behind the caster, then fires its conjured weapons in sequence at the aimed target.
somakespells:spectral_rondo: Charges forward in a spectral spin, striking twice in 360 degrees while three parallel trails of cyan Soul Pillars erupt along the path.
somakespells:spiral_of_ruin: Hurls a spectral trident that unfurls a telegraphed spiral of soul eruptions from its point of impact.
somakespells:spirit_empowerment: Applies Spirit Empowerment to yourself, granting Spirit Spell Power bonus.
somakespells:storm_aura: Creates a storm aura around you that pulls in enemies and explodes at the end, knocking everyone away.
somakespells:submerge: Applies Submerged to yourself, increasing Aqua Spell Power and Aquatic Mobility for a period of time.
somakespells:summon_drowned: Summons an allied Drowned whose health and damage scale with Aqua power.
somakespells:symmetry_empowerment: Applies Symmetry Empowerment to yourself, granting Symmetry Spell Power bonus.
somakespells:thunder_cloud: Conjures a Thunder Cloud that repeatedly strikes with Rain and Lightning.
somakespells:water_ball: Throws a water ball projectile that deals damage on impact.
somakespells:water_control: Keeps a suspended mass of water in front of you, following your aim while you channel it.
somakespells:water_spear: Launches a summoned water spear projectile at the target.
somakespells:winged_ruin: Unfurls the Possessed Paladin's original crimson wings, rises amid converging souls and dives into a selected point, unleashing the Finisher's four cardinal formations of Soul Pillar Explosions.
somakespells:withered_rose_vortex: Summons a tornado of withered rose petals at the target point. The vortex drags enemies inward, lifts them, deals Blood damage in pulses, and afflicts them with Wither.
traveloptics:abyssal_blast: Cast to fire a devastating beam of abyssal energy in a straight line. While active, caster cannot move or look around. Can only be found by defeating The Leviathan.
traveloptics:aerial_collapse: Inflict an effect that lifts enemies into the air for 2.5 seconds before crushing them down to the floor, dealing percentage-based damage to their health. The damage dealt ignores any kind of damage cap.
traveloptics:annihilation: Targets enemies and nukes them with a devastating spell that deals massive damage. Survivors are inflicted with a radiation effect, preventing incoming healing. Can only be  found from Toxic Caves ruins and by slaying Nucleepers.
traveloptics:aqua_missiles: Fires a rapid succession of water bolts that deal damage and home in on nearby entities.
traveloptics:ashen_breath: Exhale a cloud of darkening ash, damaging and blinding creatures in its reach.
traveloptics:astral_sense: Reveals the pathfinder of nearby entities in a radius. Normal casting alerts the caster about nearby threats, while crouch casting helps sense loot, traps, and valuables like Arcane Debris.
traveloptics:axe_of_the_doomed: Summon a Aptrgangr to fight by your side and unleash devastating melee attacks upon your enemies. Can only be obtained by defeating Aptrgangr.
traveloptics:blackout: Creates a lingering anti-magic field that suppresses abilities within its radius. Players caught in the zone are unable to cast spells and use items. Moving within the field inflicts small damage. Can only be obtained by defeating the Enraged Dead King.
traveloptics:blink: Low-cost, short-ranged teleport in the direction you're moving. Works omni-directionally.
traveloptics:blood_howl: Cast to shoot wither howitzer projectiles at your target. This spell has recasts.
traveloptics:bubble_spray: Sprays a stream of bubbles that deals damage, slows affected entities, and applies the Wet effect.
traveloptics:burning_judgment: Creates Ignis flame strikes on the ground in a straight line for a duration. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the strikes transform into soul-fired flame strikes. Can only be obtained by defeating Ignis.
traveloptics:call_forth_the_dead_king: Summons an Enraged Dead King boss to challenge you. Defeating it grants a higher chance of obtaining high-quality loot, including the exclusive spell Blackout. The Enraged Dead King can cast additional powerful spells. The high mana cost is intentional to make it only cast-able from scrolls. Can only be found in Catacombs Chests.
traveloptics:conjure_void_tomes: Summon magical Void Tomes to fight by your side and unleash spell attacks upon your enemies. Can be found in Void Cathedral.
traveloptics:coral_barrage: Cast to mark targets, unleashing a barrage of coral bolts at the end of recasting. Bolts damage, pierce, and shatter into shrapnel, dealing AoE damage within a 2-block radius.
traveloptics:cursed_blast: Channel the essence of darkness, unleashing a cryogenic blast that shatters the resolve of those caught within. Amplified by absorbed soul fragments. Only cast-able from Cursed Wraithblade.
traveloptics:cursed_minefield: On cast, summons Leviathan’s abyssal mines in a radius around the player. The mine placement is random, but they cannot go below the caster’s Y level.
traveloptics:cursed_revenants: Cast to summon random Draugr variants that'll protect you and fight for you.
traveloptics:death_laser: Cast to shoot The Harbinger Laser beam in a straight line. While active, caster cannot move or look around.
traveloptics:despair: Launches a magical Axe Blade forward on the look direction piercing through entities in its path. Deals damage to all caught in its trajectory.
traveloptics:echo_of_the_abyss: Summons a Hullbreaker to fight and protect the caster. Can be used as an underwater mount, granting water breathing while ridden. Can only be obtained from defeating Hullbreaker.
traveloptics:eek: Eek yourself and eek targeted entity.
traveloptics:em_pulse: Cast to stun nearby entities for a short duration. Stunned enemies has a visual indicator.
traveloptics:eternal_sentinel: Conjure a friendly Ender Golem to protect and fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Ender Golem.
traveloptics:extinction: Calls down a massive asteroid, smashing into the ground with incredible force. The impact devastates a large area, leaving a crater that erupts with searing heat, turning all within to ash. Only cast-able from Gauntlet Of Extinction.
traveloptics:flood_slash: Unleashes a aqua-infused slash projectile that deals damage and converts damage dealt into Mana for the caster. Hitting multiple entities increases the caster's Mana regeneration temporarily.
traveloptics:floodgate: Imposes a damage cap on the caster, ensuring that any incoming damage exceeding the threshold is reduced to the cap. When damage surpasses the threshold, waves surge outward in all directions, dealing damage.
traveloptics:gyro_slash: Transform the Infernal Devastator into Blade Mode, slashing entities in front of you. Using an Infernal Devastator Evo 2 or higher creates a slash projectile that pulls in nearby entities with a fiery vacuum effect before bursting into flame jets. Only cast-able from Infernal Devastator.
traveloptics:halberd_horizon: Summons Phantom Halberds in the battlefield around the caster, damaging entities caught in it. Can only be obtained by defeating Maledictus.
traveloptics:hydroshot: Fires a small water bolt that deals damage, slows enemies, and applies the wet effect.
traveloptics:ignited_onslaught: Cast to summon a Ignited Revenant & Berserker to protect you and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Ignited Revenant and Ignited Berserker.
traveloptics:jet_steam: Generates a powerful surge that propels the caster at high speed while using elytra or swimming underwater, granting temporary water breathing.
traveloptics:lava_bomb: Launches projectiles at a 45° angle in front of the caster, that explodes upon impact, creating lava pools. When cast, the spell absorbs nearby lava.
traveloptics:lingering_strain: Grants a effect; During that any burst damage you get will be split into 4 different smaller damage and will be dealt over time giving the caster time to recover.
traveloptics:magnetron_deployment: Cast to deploy a Magnetron that will follow, protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Magnetron.
traveloptics:mechanized_predator: Cast to deploy Watchers and The Prowler that will follow, protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating The Watcher and The Prowler.
traveloptics:meteor_storm: Summons Ignis fireballs to rain down from the sky. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the fireballs transform into soul-fired projectiles.
traveloptics:nocturnal_swarm: Cast to summon deadly swarm of Vesper.
traveloptics:nullflare: Cast to inflict Nullflare Ice on enemies, or Crouch Cast to inflict Nullflare Fire; when Ice meets Fire, or vice versa, it triggers a Nullflare Blast, dealing damage. Additional effect stacks increase the Blast damage.
traveloptics:orbital_void: Shoots Abyssal Orb projectiles in a circular pattern around the player, damaging entities. On the initial cast, Abyssal Orbs home in on nearby entities.
traveloptics:primal_pack: Summon Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus to fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus.
traveloptics:primordial_steed: Summon a Atlatitan that will follow you around, let you ride. Also protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Luxtructosaurus.
traveloptics:psychic_bolt: Select multiple targets on cast. On recast end, fires small projectiles that confuse targets on hit, making them prioritize attacking nearby non-player entities.
traveloptics:rainfall: Calls down a rainstorm that grants immunity to negative effects for the caster and applies the Wet effect to everyone within.
traveloptics:rapid_laser: Continuously shoots Harbinger's pew-pew laser to targeted entities.
traveloptics:reversal: Reverses any incoming damage with increased power. Additionally, it can copy incoming projectiles.
traveloptics:serpentide: Summons a cascade of Storm Serpents that strike down in a straight line one after another, dealing damage and applying Wet effect. Damage ignores i-frames. Can only be obtained by defeating Scylla.
traveloptics:shadowed_miasma: Inflicts nearby enemies with the abyssal curse effect and infuses your weapon with the same curse. Dealing damage to an enemy during the effect has a chance to spread the effect to nearby enemies.
traveloptics:shear_of_the_stars: Summons a Dragon Spirit that flies forward, passing through blocks and damaging enemies it hits. It leaves behind a Stellar Trail that deals damage over time to nearby enemies. Dragon damage ignores I-Frames. Requires Stellothorn to cast this spell.
traveloptics:skypiercer: Calls down a phantom Trident Of Eternal Maelstrom from the sky, dealing impact damage in an area. The trident remains, pulsing for 50% of the impact damage at intervals and inflicting Tidal Torment, causing thrown Trident Of Eternal Maelstrom to explode in an area and slowing affected enemies. Requires Trident Of The Eternal Maelstrom to cast this spell.
traveloptics:spectral_blink: After activation, the caster has 3 seconds. During this time, they can teleport to any entity they are looking at, even through walls. Any entities within the teleportation range will be revealed to the caster.
traveloptics:stele_cascade: Summons Ancient Desert Stele in a radius, crashing down and dealing damage.
traveloptics:sticky_steed_summon: Conjure a Gum Worm that will follow you around, let you ride. Also protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Gum Worm.
traveloptics:summon_desert_dwellers: Summon Koboletons and Wadjet to fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Koboletons and Wadjet.
traveloptics:supernova: Summon a collapsing star that builds in intensity over time. After a short delay, it erupts in a massive explosion, dealing heavy damage and gives birth to a supermassive black hole. The black hole pulls in nearby entities and continues to deal damage within its radius. Requires Wand of Final Light to cast this spell.
traveloptics:sword_of_the_ancients: Summon kobolediator to fight by your side and unleash devastating melee attacks upon your enemies. Can only be obtained by defeating Kobolediator.
traveloptics:tectonic_rift: Needs the Gauntlet of Extinction in the main hand. Tears open a ring of erupting magma around the caster that damages enemies standing in it for 10 seconds.
traveloptics:the_forgotten_beast: Summon Forsaken, a powerful, rideable creature that fight alongside you. However, beware: its will is not fully tameable, and its ferocity may prove unpredictable. Can only be obtained by defeating Forsaken.
traveloptics:the_howling_tempest: After a 3s charge, conjures a raging tempest that rains down water spears, dealing damage and applying Wet effect. Each hit has a 50% chance to either increase the Wet amplifier (up to 10x) or extend its duration by 2s. Can only be obtained by defeating Scylla.
traveloptics:tidal_grasp: Pulls a targeted entity toward the caster, striking them with force to deal damage while applying a Stun and the Wet effect.
traveloptics:tsunami: Call forth an unstoppable tide that surges forward, slamming into enemies, dealing damage, sweeping them away, and applying wet effect.
traveloptics:vigor_siphon: Cast to connect with your nearest summon. Damage dealt by the summon heals you, and your damage heals the summon in return. If you die while tethered, the linked summon is sacrificed to restore you with 8hp
traveloptics:violent_skreech: Continuously pulsate sound blast to Shred Armor, Damage Nearby enemies and Applying Chilled effect. 2% of damage deal converted into lifesteal.
traveloptics:void_devourer: Creates a Dimensional Rift that pulls everything around it and damages enemies caught in it.
traveloptics:void_eruption: Shoots Void Howitzer Projectiles that explode and summon void runes in a radius. This spell can be recast.
traveloptics:vortex_of_the_deep: Conjures a massive water vortex that pulls entities toward its center, slowing them and applying Wet effect. The vortex periodically discharges Boltstrikes to devastate those within it's radius.
traveloptics:vortex_punch: Create a Void Vortex, pulling enemies in. Teleport into it and unleash a crushing uppercut, dealing damage and sending foes flying upward.
wind_spellbooks:aeropic: Leap forward in a spinning, voltaic attack that will damage your first target and launch you into the air. As long as you hit your target, the attack can be repeated.
wind_spellbooks:almighty_push: Create a area of wind around you knocking back creatures in every directions, causing damage if they impact a wall
wind_spellbooks:iron_slash: Focus yourself before doing a big dash that slash your enemies
wind_spellbooks:tailwind: Imbue yourself with the strength of the wind, increasing your speed and your mobility in the air.
wind_spellbooks:tornado: Around a targeted location, create a tornado that will suck in nearby creatures and propulse them in the air
wind_spellbooks:wind_blade: Slash forward to send out a concentrated blade of wind, slicing through creatures
